failures.source: This was the selected option; the section <g1>Extensions to the lockbox funding stream</g1> was previously referred to as "Option 1" of this ZIP. ZIP 1016 <g2><g3>2</g3></g2> set the <x4/> parameter to 12%, and the <x5/> parameter to Mainnet block height 4406400, equal to that of the Zcash Community Grants stream so that both streams end at Zcash's 3rd halving under the pre-NU7 block spacing. ZIP 214 Revision 3 <g6><g7>17</g7></g6> adjusts the end height to the revised third halving if NU7 activates before the original end height.
